action: Formalized the reduction obligation in Dittert/Reduction.lean: the feasible set is compact and Phi is continuous, so a maximizer exists; Phi at the uniform matrix equals 2 - gamma n; for two rows i, k of a matrix the mixing line (row i becomes (1-t) A i + t A k, row k the complementary mix) preserves the total and the column sums, the row product moves by t(1-t)(r_i - r_k)^2 times the other row sums, the column product is constant, and the permanent is per A + t(1-t)(per A_{k<-i} + per A_{i<-k} - 2 per A) by additivity of the permanent in one row (proved from the column form and transposition, since Mathlib v4.33.1 lacks it); hence Phi is Phi A + alpha t(1-t) along the line; a positive maximizer is feasible on both sides of t = 0, which forces alpha = 0, so Phi is constant along the line, and following the line to the first vanishing entry produces a maximizer with a zero unless the two rows agree; therefore, under the hypothesis that every maximizer is positive, all rows agree, all columns agree by transposition, and the maximizer is the uniform matrix; installed the frozen project and ran the controlled formal check of Dittert.reduction.
